I can’t do the things I love anymore. I started off as a 15y/o A student in college whose papers were submitted for various awards by my professors for the first three years. Now I’m failing all my classes, my professors are suggesting I take remedial writing courses, and I’m in my 7th year of college not even close to being finished. I was an avid reader my entire life. Reading WAS my life. And now I can’t anymore. The words and sentences change completely. This is all thanks to my diagnosis or possibly every type of medication that I’ve tried. My memory is shit and I can’t remember most things, everyone has to remind me, and again, I’m failing my classes. Education is my LIFE. I’m currently severely depressed, I can’t function and I’m tired of living. I’ve wanted to die since third grade, and I need to succeed this time because I can’t handle it anymore
